resources.string: %1$s · okuqondisiwe okulondoloziwe, hhayi ubunikazi bedivayisi obuqinisekisiwe
Ubunikazi benqubo eqondisiwe abuqinisekisiwe. Iphrofayela elondoloziwe noma ifayela lokucushwa elifanayo alifakazeli lokho okubonayo olunye uhlelo lokusebenza.
Izinhlelo zokusebenza zizuza njengefa lokhu okumisiwe okulondoloziwe ngaphandle uma zinenqubomgomo yangokwezifiso. Ukulondoloza akuyenzi injini isebenze.
Amanani abhekiwe avela kule nqubo MaxManager futhi angase ashintshwe kakade yimojuli yangaphandle yomhlaba. Akuwona amanani wangempela wehadiwe aqinisekisiwe.
Kwabiwe Nobunikazi Bedivayisi. Izinguquko zivela kuzo zombili izikrini; le nqubomgomo izimele kuzilungiselelo zokusebenza.
Ikhutshaziwe kunqubomgomo elondoloziwe; ukukhishwa kwesikhathi sokusebenza akuqinisekisiwe
Ihuku lomhlaba wonke langaphandle alikwazi ukuhlehliswa ngokususa umsebenzi ozokwenziwa wohlelo lokusebenza. Le nhlanganisela idinga i-adaptha yokuzihlukanisa futhi ivinjelwe ukuthi ingasebenza.
Khetha iphrofayela ukuze unike amandla Okwezifiso. Ukuhlela iphrofayela eyabiwe kubuyekeza lonke uhlelo lokusebenza olubhekisela kuyo.
Khetha uhlelo lokusebenza noma faka igama lephakheji elivumelekile.

Izinkambu zobunikazi akumele zingabi nalutho. Izigxivizo zeminwe ozikhethela zona kufanele zisebenzise ifomethi ye-Android futhi zifane nomkhiqizo/umkhiqizo/idivayisi. Azikho izihlonzi noma izinguquko ezingeni le-API lohlaka.
Ubunikazi obungavumelekile noma izigxivizo zeminwe ezingqubuzanayo. Lungisa amanani ngaphambi kokulondoloza.
Le phrofayela engenisiwe iqukethe inani lelegacy leleveli ye-API. Ukulungiselela kuyakwenqaba; ukulondoloza lesi sihleli kusisusa ngaphandle kokushintsha uhlaka lomsingathi.

Susa %1$s? Izabelo zayo zohlelo lokusebenza ziyakhutshazwa esikhundleni sokuthola ifa lomhlaba buthule. Isithenjwa somhlaba wonke esilondoloziwe sisuliwe. Ukucushwa kwenjini akushintshile kuze kusetshenziswe ngokusobala.

Lokhu kulungiselela ukucushwa kwakamuva okulondoloziwe nge-arbiter yokulawula. Amafayela omhlaba kanye nawohlelo lokusebenza ngalunye ayimisebenzi ehlukene, hhayi into eyodwa ye-athomu. Umsuka ungacelwa. Ukucushwa kokufunda emuva kuhloliwe; ubunikazi benqubo abukho. Umjikelezo wokuphila wemojuli yangaphandle/ukuqalisa kabusha kungase kudingeke. Irekhodi lokuthola kabusha eliyimfihlo ligcinwa ngaphambi kokubhala; ukutholwa kokucushwa kuhlala kutholakala ngemuva kokuqala kabusha MaxManager. Qinisekisa kuphela kudivayisi okungeyakho noma ogunyazwe ukuyihlola.
Lezi zifunda zichaza ukufaneleka kwe-adaptha/ukulungiselela, hhayi usekelo lwehuku lwe-Android olujwayelekile. Akukho ukulawula okubhalekayo endaweni engasetshenziswanga.
Inkambu yokucushwa ye-COPG ebhalwe phansi · umphumela wenqubo awuqinisekisiwe
Funda kuphela · Izinga le-API yohlaka alishintshiwe
Enye imephu ye-COPG isivele ingumnikazi wale phakheji. Akukho ukungena kwamanye amazwe okuye kwabhalwa ngaphezulu.
Inqubomgomo engasekelwe/ingxenye, izigxivizo zeminwe ezingqubuzanayo, ileveli ye-API yefa, noma izinkambu zomhlaba ezithuthukile zangaphandle. Akukho ukucushwa okubhaliwe.
Imojuli edingekayo ayikho, ivaliwe, iyabuyekezwa, noma ilinde ukususwa.

Ilungisa i-COPG-VD JSON kuphela; ayisayinzi i-resetprop noma iqalise kabusha. Izinkambu ezikhona ezithuthukile ziyenqatshwa kunokuba zisuswe. Kusebenza isikhathi sokusebenza somhlaba wonke, uku-oda kwe-cross-engine, ukubuyisela ukuqalisa kabusha kwezinga lesakhiwo, nokuhlukaniswa kohlelo lokusebenza kusadinga i-adaptha/ukuqinisekiswa kwedivayisi.
Ukubuyisela emuva akukwazanga ukuqinisekiswa · buyekeza injini ukucushwa
Inqubomgomo yesigaba · ukuhlola kuqala okuhlosiwe kuphela; I-Real under Global idinga ukuhlukaniswa

Buyisela ukulungiselelwa kwangaphambilini okulondolozwe ngaphambi komsebenzi wakamuva, ngisho nangemva kokuqalisa kabusha MaxManager. Lokhu kubuyisela ifayela, hhayi izakhiwo ezibukhoma noma ukusebenzisa izinqubo zohlelo lokusebenza. Ifayela elingafundeki noma ukuguqulwa kwangaphandle kuvimbe ukubuyisela. Asikho isicelo sempande esizenzakalelayo noma ukubuyisela ekuqaleni.
Isitoreji sokutakula asikwazanga ukuqinisekiswa. Ukubhala kuvinjiwe; ungayisusi ijenali ngaphambi kokuyibuyekeza.
Akukho ukucushwa kwangaphambilini okutholakalayo ukuze kutholakale
Umsebenzi ophazamisekile noma ongaxazululiwe · buyekeza ukutholwa ngaphambi kokunye ukubhala
Ukucushwa kushintshile ngemva kokuqinisekisa. Buyekeza ithagethi entsha bese uqinisekise futhi.

Izendlalelo ezizimele zomjovo womhlaba wonke kanye nohlelo ngalunye zikhona zombili. Uku-oda/ukuhlukaniswa kwabo akuqinisekisiwe; ukulungiswa kuvinjiwe kunokuthembisa ubunikazi bohlelo lokusebenza ngokwezifiso.
